Updates writable workload-deployment configuration without modifying immutable DeploymentInput snapshots. It reads the current snapshot only for comparison, resolves every changed relationship exactly, validates retained or supplied blueprint overrides against the selected definition, records validated pre-mutation ModTime for diagnostics and re-reads the item, but the request atomic cannot transmit a version precondition. Arrays are full replacements only when supplied; omitted arrays are preserved. ChangesScheduled is reported as accepted pending Deploy, not as applied configuration. ResourcePool and StartIndex support follow CiscoDevNet intersight-python commit 0e8dfdb798aac11684966f0edbbd5e5ea3106dff / OpenAPI 1.0.11-2026072720 and conflict with the older checked-in February schema, so import and live-tenant validation remain required. Prefix uniqueness is a precheck with a disclosed race window; the separate lookup and PATCH also have an unavoidable concurrent same-item race.

properties.description: Requires exactly one deployment and validates its identity, concrete type, and Organization relationship before item retrieval.
properties.script:
import json
import re
import sys

status = "invalid"
failureCode = "502"
failureMessage = "Deployment response was invalid"
failureError = "The deployment lookup response could not be validated."
failureResult = "{}"
deploymentMoid = ""
expectedName = sys.argv[1]
organizationMoid = sys.argv[2]
moidPattern = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._~-]{0,127}$")
try:
    envelope = json.loads(sys.argv[3])
    results = envelope.get("Results") if isinstance(envelope, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(results, list):
        raise ValueError("Results is not an array.")
    if len(results) == 0:
        failureCode = "404"
        failureMessage = "Workload deployment was not found"
        failureError = "The exact organization-scoped deployment lookup returned zero matches."
        failureResult = json.dumps({"error":failureMessage,"matchCount":0,"Deployment":expectedName}, separators=(",",":"))
    elif len(results) != 1:
        failureCode = "409"
        failureMessage = "Deployment lookup was ambiguous"
        failureError = "The exact deployment lookup returned " + str(len(results)) + " matches; exactly one is required."
        failureResult = json.dumps({"error":failureMessage,"matchCount":len(results),"Deployment":expectedName}, separators=(",",":"))
    else:
        item = results[0]
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            raise ValueError("The single result is not an object.")
        deploymentMoid = str(item.get("Moid","")).strip()
        if not moidPattern.fullmatch(deploymentMoid):
            raise ValueError("The deployment Moid is missing or unsafe.")
        if str(item.get("Name","")).strip() != expectedName:
            raise ValueError("The returned deployment Name does not match exactly.")
        if item.get("ClassId") != "workload.WorkloadDeployment" or item.get("ObjectType") != "workload.WorkloadDeployment":
            raise ValueError("The deployment discriminators are inconsistent.")
        organization = item.get("Organization")
        if not isinstance(organization, dict) or str(organization.get("Moid","")).strip() != organizationMoid:
            raise ValueError("The deployment Organization relationship does not match.")
        if str(organization.get("ObjectType","")).strip() != "organization.Organization":
            raise ValueError("The deployment Organization relationship has the wrong ObjectType.")
        status = "ready"
        failureCode = failureMessage = failureError = ""
        failureResult = "{}"
except Exception as exc:
    deploymentMoid = ""
    failureError = "The deployment response failed validation: " + str(exc)
    failureResult = json.dumps({"error":failureMessage,"details":failureError}, separators=(",",":"))

properties.description: Validates returned identity, organization, ModTime, documented status/action enums, definition relationship, and optional current input relationship.
properties.script:
import datetime
import json
import re
import sys

status = "invalid"
failureCode = "502"
failureMessage = "Deployment item response was invalid"
failureError = "The exact deployment item could not be validated."
failureResult = "{}"
deploymentJson = ""
deploymentMoid = sys.argv[1]
expectedName = sys.argv[2]
organizationMoid = sys.argv[3]
modTime = ""
deploymentStatus = ""
lastAction = ""
actionValue = ""
definitionMoid = ""
deploymentInputMoid = ""
hasDeploymentInput = "false"
moidPattern = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._~-]{0,127}$")
try:
    item = json.loads(sys.argv[4])
    if not isinstance(item, dict):
        raise ValueError("The item response is not an object.")
    if str(item.get("Moid","")).strip() != deploymentMoid or not moidPattern.fullmatch(deploymentMoid):
        raise ValueError("The item Moid does not match the resolved deployment.")
    if str(item.get("Name","")).strip() != expectedName:
        raise ValueError("The item Name does not match exactly.")
    if item.get("ClassId") != "workload.WorkloadDeployment" or item.get("ObjectType") != "workload.WorkloadDeployment":
        raise ValueError("The item discriminators are inconsistent.")
    organization = item.get("Organization")
    if not isinstance(organization, dict) or str(organization.get("Moid","")).strip() != organizationMoid:
        raise ValueError("The item Organization relationship does not match.")
    if str(organization.get("ObjectType","")).strip() != "organization.Organization":
        raise ValueError("The Organization relationship has the wrong ObjectType.")
    modTime = str(item.get("ModTime","")).strip()
    if not modTime:
        raise ValueError("ModTime is missing.")
    datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(modTime.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
    deploymentStatus = str(item.get("Status","")).strip()
    allowedStatuses = {"Draft","ReadyToDeploy","InProgress","Ok","Failed","ChangesScheduled","Suspended"}
    if deploymentStatus not in allowedStatuses:
        raise ValueError("Status is missing or outside the documented enum.")
    lastAction = str(item.get("LastAction","None")).strip()
    actionValue = str(item.get("Action","None")).strip()
    allowedActions = {"None","PrepareToDeploy","Deploy","Suspend","Retry","Resume","Undeploy","ReEvaluateQualifiers"}
    if lastAction not in allowedActions or actionValue not in allowedActions:
        raise ValueError("Action or LastAction is outside the documented enum.")
    definition = item.get("WorkloadDefinition")
    if not isinstance(definition, dict):
        raise ValueError("WorkloadDefinition relationship is missing.")
    definitionMoid = str(definition.get("Moid","")).strip()
    if not moidPattern.fullmatch(definitionMoid) or str(definition.get("ObjectType","")).strip() != "workload.WorkloadDefinition":
        raise ValueError("WorkloadDefinition relationship is incomplete.")
    currentInput = item.get("DeploymentInput")
    if currentInput not in (None, {}):
        if not isinstance(currentInput, dict):
            raise ValueError("DeploymentInput is not a relationship object.")
        deploymentInputMoid = str(currentInput.get("Moid","")).strip()
        if not moidPattern.fullmatch(deploymentInputMoid) or str(currentInput.get("ObjectType","")).strip() != "workload.DeploymentInput":
            raise ValueError("DeploymentInput relationship is incomplete.")
        hasDeploymentInput = "true"
    deploymentJson = json.dumps(item, separators=(",",":"), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False)
    status = "ready"
    failureCode = failureMessage = failureError = ""
    failureResult = "{}"
except Exception as exc:
    deploymentJson = ""
    modTime = deploymentStatus = lastAction = actionValue = definitionMoid = deploymentInputMoid = ""
    hasDeploymentInput = "false"
    failureError = "The deployment item failed validation: " + str(exc)
    failureResult = json.dumps({"error":failureMessage,"details":failureError}, separators=(",",":"))

        organization = item.get("Organization")

            raise ValueError("The related resource Organization relationship does not match.")
        status = "ready"

        failureResult = "{}"
except Exception as exc:
    if failureCode == "502":
        failureError = label + " response failed validation: " + str(exc)
